label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
**To:** Bethan only (not reply all)
**Subject:** Re: Nia's hen

Hiya Beth,

Just landed off Lagos so excuse me if this rambles, but I wanted to message you on your own and not on the group one.

I'm not going to tell you what to do and I'm not taking sides, I promise. I just don't want you to miss this if there's a way round it. I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get the weekend off, and I really wanted that night stop, so you know I'm keen for us all to be there. And it's Nia. You sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019, and she's not forgotten that. She rang me last week in a bit of a state asking if you were still coming, and she doesn't know you've pulled out yet.

So what about just doing the Saturday? You only need to be in Tenby for 6. Skip the cottage Friday and skip the paddleboarding if you like. There's a train from Cardiff Central, about two and a half hours, and I'll pick you up from the station. You can share my room, I've got the twin, so you won't be stuck in the cottage with anyone you'd rather avoid. Just come for the meal and we'll see how it goes.

I think Lowri's sorry underneath, she's just as stubborn as you are, the pair of you. I'm not saying that to give you a row, honest. I just think a night with everyone there might do more than a few weeks of silence.

Also, can you hang on before sending her the £85? No rush on that and I'd rather you didn't send it yet.

And then there's Margam on the 17th April, you've got your reading to do. It'd be nice for you and Nia to get there with this behind you.

Have a think and ring me if you want to talk it through.

Siân x

reasons: It omits that both women said things at Lowri's 40th, and that Bethan may regret missing the hen and Nia will remember her absence.
